name: Free Table
tagline: A real deck on a virtual table. Play any game, house rules welcome.
rulesSummary: No rules and no turns: deal, draw, play, discard and bet however your game works. Anyone can do anything at any time.
Tap cards to select them, then pick an action. Swipe a card up to play it face up. ✕ Clear, or a tap on the felt, deselects everything.
Tap the deck to draw. Tap cards on the table, or the top of the discard pile (face up or down), to select them, then Take to pick them up.
Rummy-style: Lay down meld puts cards in front of you. To add to anyone's meld, select your cards and one card of that meld, then Add to meld.
Pass… puts selected cards into another player's hand: your left, your right, or anyone you choose.
The ••• menu has more: play or discard face down, put cards on the deck, flip, turn up the top card, deal, shuffle, sort, bet, take the pot, and Collect & shuffle all.
Undo (in •••) takes back the last move, whoever made it.
